segments.source: Magenta Prestige brings a current North American thirteen-specialty menu and automatic milk carafe to a compact machine with a small color display. It is attractive when one-touch milk matters more than storing separate named profiles: beverage customization is available, but several users do not each get a personal account on the machine. The ceramic grinder offers five positions, giving another reason to judge the intended coffee routine realistically. Its Over-Ice program and regional menu need to be distinguished from the twelve-beverage global version. The practical appeal is broad drink access from a small station, with carafe care included in the daily work.
